title: Final velocity calculation
description: Essential: The response must give the final velocity as 5100 m/s (or equivalent in scientific notation).

title: Final height calculation
description: Essential: The response must give the final height as 2.655 × 10⁵ m (or 265500 m).

title: First-stage kinematics
description: Important: Correctly calculates the velocity (600 m/s) and displacement (9000 m) at the end of the first 30-second burn.

title: Second-stage kinematics
description: Important: Correctly applies v = v₀ + at and an appropriate displacement formula (e.g., average velocity method) for the 60-second second-stage burn.

title: Displacement summation
description: Important: Adds the displacement from the first and second stages to find the total height.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Includes correct units (m/s, m) with final answers and maintains unit consistency in intermediate steps.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses a negative value for the upward acceleration, or incorrectly treats the motion as deceleration.

title: Stage time confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong time interval (e.g., 90 s instead of 60 s) for the second-stage acceleration calculation.
